name: OneDrive
author: GittyIO
description: Sync status, recent file changes, pause/resume and a folder picker for the OneDrive Client for Linux (abraunegg) in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: See whether OneDrive is up to date, pause or resume syncing, and open recently synced files.

schema.label: Service name
schema.description: The systemd unit that runs the client, e.g. onedrive or onedrive-work.

schema.label: Service type
schema.description: System services are shown read-only: pause, sync now and the folder picker need a user service.

schema.label: Folder picker
schema.description: Lets you choose synced folders. It reads folder names from Microsoft using the client's sign-in.
